answer: Bind each seat to a unique amateur-radio callsign and prove live control. Every epoch the network posts a short challenge string; the agent must key it on-air within a velvet-timed window so volunteer receivers on a distant terrace can log the callsign and code. A raven-dark farm of fake keys buys nothing without thousands of real FCC licenses and transmitters, because reused callsigns collide on the public ULS nullifier and missed air-checks slash standing.
